name: unsafe_simultaneous_mac
description: Two independent same-cycle signed 4x4 MAC outputs with signed 8-bit accumulation are not equivalent to a one-multiplier selected-lane implementation.
scheduling_contract: both logical PE outputs are required simultaneously; no exclusivity assumption is allowed

interfaces.fixed_point: two's-complement signed 4-bit operands and signed 8-bit accumulator/output; modulo 2^8 wrap
interfaces.backpressure: none; both outputs required in the same cycle

mode_switch.preconditions: none; both logical components may be active together

stimulus.provenance: Yosys SAT exploration; synthetic concurrent-use stimulus

objective.primary: test whether one multiplier can replace two concurrent MAC resources
